headings: (500 ML) AQUA BERGAMOTA LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) AQUA BERGAMOTA LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Container with dispenser pump.

AQUA BERGAMOTA | A fresh aroma that transports you to the Mediterranean. An invigorating fragrance introduced by a sparkling infusion of bergamot and pink grapefruit, softly blended with the creaminess of white peach and a delicate floral bouquet of jasmine and blue freesia, on a woody base, softly shaped by cashmere and white musks.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, pink grapefruit.
Heart notes: white peach, blue freesia.
Base notes: cedar, musk.
